messages:
olivia (support): Hey — customer says their free trial is blocked with 'account requires manual review'. They signed up with joe@mailinator.com and mentioned using a VPN. UI shows 'trial on hold'. Can someone check the risk flags? :thinking:

security-bot: Automated risk score 0.87. Flags: disposable_email, proxy_detected, billing_country_mismatch. Evidence ID rf_98765.

sam (fraud-ops): Thanks. maria, can you pull the signup headers + payment BIN? Also check if there's an existing account link for that email/phone. If customer is legit we can do KBA/OTP.

maria (support-engineer): Pulling logs now. Example curl to fetch internal trace: curl -H 'X-Trace-ID: 1759123456' 'https://internal-logs/recent?user=joe@mailinator.com' -> got IP 45.33.21.8 (PacketStream), UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0)'. Billing addr country = CA, card BIN -> US issuer. Country mismatch = 1.

olivia (support): Customer replied in thread — happy to do phone SMS or upload ID. Wants trial asap.

sam (fraud-ops): For manual override we require at least one KBA step: phone OTP plus last-4 card match, and ideally an ID selfie. Support can initiate OTP. @kevin any compliance concerns? :thumbsup:

kevin (compliance): No objections. If ID looks valid we can grant a single 7-day trial. Please redact all PII in case notes.

maria (support-engineer): Created manual review MR-2026-1123, linked evidence rf_98765. After OTP success I'll run internal grant: /admin/grant_trial --user joe@mailinator.com --duration 7d --note 'manual KBA'.

olivia (support): Sent OTP to +1-555-0199 (customer provided).

security-bot: Action log: otp_sent, ticket_created MR-2026-1123, reviewer sam.

olivia (support): OTP verified and ID screenshot received (redacted). Proceeding with grant.

sam (fraud-ops): Approved. @maria please run the grant script and tag account 'trial-manual-verified'. Confirm when done.

maria (support-engineer): Done. grant id g_20260317_001. Trial active for 7d. Added internal note and closed MR-2026-1123.

olivia (support): Notified customer — trial active. Closing thread.
